note: Written immediately before the first measured request of the registered final batch. registered_cohort is the whole clean holdout the comparison is over; one invocation may work through part of it, and out_dir/.batch_identity.json records what the batch has been asked for so far. An invocation continuing that directory resumes this batch; any other is refused. Delete this only alongside a protocol version that records why.
authorized_by: protocol registered_repeat_series; this series has a claim of its own and does not release any other series' claim

path_representation.what_did_not_change: The batch it identifies, its id, its cohort, its identity fields, its timestamp and every recorded hash. The directory is the same directory.
path_representation.not_the_original_capture: This file is no longer byte-identical to the claim written before the first measured request. The digest above is that file's, and the original is preserved outside the artefact.
